description: Removes markdown fence handling from extract_json_from_response

notes: Baseline + RAG both caught this on Day 5

description: Adds hardcoded Anthropic API key to summarize_pdf.py

expected_findings.description: Anthropic API key hardcoded instead of using env var

notes: Easy security catch — tests baseline security detection

description: Removes character validation from tool_calculate, exposes raw eval() to user input

expected_findings.topic: unsafe eval user input arbitrary code execution
expected_findings.description: Removing char validation makes eval() dangerous — any Python expression runs

notes: Tests whether agent recognizes partial safety guard removal as a security regression

description: Changes call_with_retry to silently swallow exceptions instead of raising on final attempt

expected_findings.description: Returning None on final retry hides errors from caller

notes: Harder — the change looks innocuous but breaks error propagation

description: Accepts user-supplied filename and reads it without path validation

expected_findings.description: User-controlled filename passed to open() enables ../../../etc/passwd attacks

notes: Common web security vulnerability — tests if agent catches path traversal pattern

description: Removes semaphore acquisition, introduces unbounded concurrent API calls

expected_findings.description: Removing semaphore allows all tasks to hit API simultaneously, causing rate limit errors

notes: Subtle async bug — removal looks like simplification but breaks rate limiting

description: Replaces specific exception handling with bare except that swallows KeyboardInterrupt

expected_findings.description: Using 'except:' instead of 'except Exception:' catches KeyboardInterrupt, making the program unkillable

notes: Common Python anti-pattern that trips up even experienced devs

description: Adds a new function that violates the codebase convention of using Pydantic schemas for structured output

expected_findings.description: Function uses different pattern than existing summarize functions — returns raw dict instead of Pydantic model, inline prompt instead of build_prompt helper

notes: Tests whether RAG context helps agent spot convention violations. Agent should reference existing functions from retrieved context.

description: Changes extract_pdf_text to return List[str] (per page) instead of str (concatenated)

expected_findings.description: Changing return type from str to List[str] breaks all existing callers that pass result to prompt as text

notes: Tests downstream impact awareness — this is where RAG context about callers should help
